2) Crea con Write E:/Projects/The Four/evidence/4d_hash_probe.gd, literal:
extends SceneTree
## Area 4d (spec_proporcion D13): a hash of the manifest of each seed from 1 to 40, so
## that a change meant only for speed shows it left them as they were. --out=<file in evidence/>.
const GEN := preload("res://game/world/generation/office_generator.gd")

func _initialize() -> void:
	var out := "4d_hash.txt"
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--out="): out = arg.substr(6)
	var lines := PackedStringArray()
	var stats := {}
	var fallbacks := 0
	var began := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	for run_seed in range(1, 41):
		var generator = GEN.new()
		var data: Dictionary = generator.generate(run_seed, 2)
		var fell := bool(data.get("fallback", false))
		if fell: fallbacks += 1
		lines.append("seed=%d hash=%d attempt=%d fallback=%s" % [run_seed, hash(var_to_str(data)), int(data.get("attempt", -1)), str(fell)])
		for key in generator.stats: stats[key] = int(stats.get(key, 0)) + int(generator.stats[key])
	var file := FileAccess.open("res://evidence/" + out, FileAccess.WRITE)
	file.store_string("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
	file.close()
	print("HASH_PROBE seeds=40 fallbacks=%d stats=%s seconds=%.1f" % [fallbacks, str(stats), float(Time.get_ticks_msec() - began) / 1000.0])
	quit(0)

## {clip, posed, offered}: posed 0, no place on this floor; offered 0, the offer;

func staged_partition(sight) -> Dictionary:
	var out := {"clip": "", "posed": 0, "offered": 0}
	for room in level.manifest.rooms:
		if FLOOR.is_void(room): continue
		for item in room.get("furniture", []):
			if String(item.kind) != "partition": continue
			var at: Vector3 = FLOOR.position_of(room) + Vector3(float(item.at[0]), 0, float(item.at[1]))
			var normal: Vector3 = Basis(Vector3.UP, int(item.turn) * PI / 2) * Vector3(0, 0, 1)
			for flip in [1.0, -1.0]:
				for back in [10.5, 12.0, 14.0, 18.0]:
					var stand: Vector3 = at + normal * flip * back
					stand.y = at.y + 0.04
					if FLOOR.room_at(level.manifest.rooms, stand).is_empty() or level.point_protected(stand): continue
					await stand_at(stand)
					for turn in [deg_to_rad(35.0), deg_to_rad(-35.0)]:
						var to: Vector3 = at - stand
						level.player.rotation.y = atan2(-to.x, -to.z) + turn
						level.player.camera.rotation.x = 0.0
						await physics_frame
						out.posed += 1
						for _try in 8: # SPOTS_MOST cuts a shuffled list
							for spot in lies.sight_spots(sight, level.player.camera):
								if String(spot.kind) != "partition": continue
								out.offered += 1
								if sight.place_spot(spot, level.player.camera):
